source: Written by Claude Code from the numbers on this view, 1 Jan to 31 Oct 2026

overall.working: Google clicks grew from 1,587 in Jan to 2,247 in Oct, up 42%.
overall.not_working: 62.5% of keyword clicks come from people already searching for Opsera. AI tools sent only 70 to 110 visits a month, with no clear rise.

forge.working: Clicks rose from 11 in Jan to 481 in Oct. Infrasity's pages brought 547 of the 1,552 clicks, and AI tool visits jumped to 32 in Oct.
forge.not_working: "software factory" was shown 14,992 times but sits at spot 9.5, so it brought just 64 clicks. The /software-factory page slipped from spot 6.0 in late Sep to 12.1 in late Oct.

insights.working: AI tools sent 290 visits, the most of any product. The AI coding benchmark report and the Cursor adoption blog brought 141 of them.
insights.not_working: Clicks fell from 828 in Jul to 266 in Oct, as the Cursor explainer dropped from 563 to 78. The term "unified insights" brought only 28 clicks.
